news.title: Anirit Ventures Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 12, 2026
news.body: Anirit Ventures Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 12, 2026

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 200% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.title: Anirit Ventures Limited has completed a Follow-on Equity Offering in the amount of INR 396 million.
news.body:
Anirit Ventures Limited has completed a Follow-on Equity Offering in the amount of INR 396 million.

Security Name: Equity shares
Security Type: Common Stock
Securities Offered: 12,000,000
Price\Range: INR 33

Transaction Features: Regulation S; Rights Offering

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 15% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (15% average weekly change).

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.14 loss per share (vs ₹0.08 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.14 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.08 loss in 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹8.58m (loss widened ₹8.08m from 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 33% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 106% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
